# Junk Buddies

Junk Buddies LLC provides junk removal services in Houston, Texas, with upfront pricing, flexible scheduling, and no payment until the job is complete.

## Main resources

- [Homepage](https://junkbuddies.info/) — Main Junk Buddies website and instant pricing experience.
- [Service Areas](https://junkbuddies.info/service-areas) — Cities and areas served by Junk Buddies.
- [FAQ](https://junkbuddies.info/faq) — Common questions about junk removal, scheduling, payment, and accepted items.
- [Blog](https://junkbuddies.info/blog) — Junk removal pricing, disposal, recycling, and preparation guides.
- [Partners](https://junkbuddies.info/partners) — Information for businesses interested in partnering with Junk Buddies.
- [Schedule](https://junkbuddies.info/schedule) — Pickup scheduling flow.
